definition: Xp11.2 duplication is a genomic variation marked by the [duplication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene_duplication) of an [X chromosome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_chromosome) region on the short arm p at position 11.2, defined by standard karyotyping ([G-banding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G_banding)).

XPB ([xeroderma pigmentosum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xeroderma_pigmentosum) type B) is an [ATP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adenosine_triphosphate)-dependent [DNA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNA) [helicase](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helicase) in humans that is a part of the [TFIIH](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TFIIH) [transcription factor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transcription_factor) complex.
XPG-I is a [protein domain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein_domain) found on Xeroderma Pigmentosum Complementation Group G (XPG) protein.
Exportin-4 is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) that in humans is encoded by the XPO4 [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene).

Xq28 is a [chromosome band](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromosome_band) and [genetic marker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genetic_marker) situated at the tip of the [X chromosome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_chromosome) which has been studied since at least 1980.

49,XXYYY syndrome is an [intersex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intersex) variation in which a person has two extra [Y chromosomes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Y_chromosome) and one extra [X chromosome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_chromosome).

XYYY syndrome, also known as 48,XYYY, is a [chromosomal disorder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromosomal_disorder) in which a male has two extra copies of the [Y chromosome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Y_chromosome).

XYYYY syndrome, also known as 49,XYYYY, is an exceptionally rare [chromosomal disorder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromosomal_disorder) in which a male human has three additional copies of the [Y chromosome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Y_chromosome).

definition: YAP1 (yes-associated protein 1), also known as YAP or YAP65, is a protein that acts as a [transcription coregulator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transcription_coregulator) that promotes transcription of genes involved in [cellular proliferation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cellular_proliferation) and suppressing [apoptotic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apoptosis) genes.
YCL064C is a gene in the genome of [Saccharomyces cerevisiae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae), the most common species of [yeast](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yeast).

yeast mitochondrial code (translation table 3) is a [genetic code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genetic_code) used by the [mitochondria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mitochondria)l genome of yeasts, notably [Saccharomyces cerevisiae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae), [Candida glabrata](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Candida_glabrata), [Hansenula saturnus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hansenula_saturnus), and [Kluyveromyces thermotolerans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kluyveromyces_thermotolerans).
yotari mouse is an [autosomal recessive](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recessive_gene) mutant.

Young–Madders syndrome, alternatively known as pseudotrisomy 13 syndrome or holoprosencephaly–polydactyly syndrome, is a [genetic disorder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genetic_disorder) resulting from defective and duplicated [chromosome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromosome)s which result in [holoprosencephaly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Holoprosencephaly), [polydactyly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polydactyly), facial malformations and [intellectual disability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intellectual_disability), with a significant variance in the severity of symptoms being seen across known cases.

Young–Simpson syndrome (YSS) is a rare [congenital disorder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congenital_disorder) with symptoms including [hypothyroidism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypothyroidism), [heart defects](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heart_defects), [facial](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Face) [dysmorphism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dysmorphism), [cryptorchidism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptorchidism) in males, [hypotonia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypotonia), [intellectual disability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intellectual_disability), and [postnatal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Postnatal) [growth retardation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Growth_retardation).

definition: Yt antigen system (also known as Cartwright) is present on the [membrane](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cell_membrane) of [red blood cells](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_blood_cells) and helps determine a person's [blood type](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blood_type).
YTH domain family, member 1 is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) that in humans is encoded by the YTHDF1 [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene).

Zinc finger and BTB domain containing 1 is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) in humans that is encoded by the ZBTB1 [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene).
Zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 21 is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) that in humans is encoded by the ZBTB21 [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene).

Zinc finger and BTB domain containing 48 (ZBTB48), also known as telomeric zinc-finger associated protein (TZAP), is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) that directly binds to the double-stranded repeat sequence of [telomeres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telomeres).
Zinc finger CCCH-type containing 12A is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) in humans that is encoded by the ZC3H12A [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene).
Zinc finger CCCH domain-containing protein 13 is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) that in humans is encoded by the ZC3H13 [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene).

Nuclear-interacting partner of ALK (NIPA), also known as zinc finger C3HC-type protein 1 (ZC3HC1), is a [protein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein) that in humans is encoded by the ZC3HC1 [gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene) on [chromosome 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromosome_7_(human)).
